goal.objective: Actively consume the already-merged one-shot G18 resident execution request on an eligible deployment-local sovereign runtime by refreshing already-local source and invoking the existing request consumer, without waiting for a filesystem watcher event and without minting or replacing the existing G18 claim/fence.
success_predicates: A deployment-local resident WorkerCoordinator registry is present.
The exact existing G18 claim SHWP-SHWP-DURABLE-RUNTIME-ACTIVATION-G18 at fence18 is observed before consumption.
Already-local source is refreshed into the resident runtime without network fetch or credential acquisition.
The existing G18 request consumer records ATTEMPT_RECORDED or a matching prior ALREADY_CONSUMED state.
No new G18 claim/fence, HeartBeat authority, third-party runtime, or credential authority is created.
failure_predicates: Hosted CI is treated as resident execution evidence.
A new G18 claim/fence is minted or the existing fence18 identity is replaced.
Source is fetched over a network or a GitHub/provider credential is acquired.
A missing sovereign resident is converted into a second-machine requirement by default.

no G18 claim/fence creation or replacement
